observations: Willis silhouette, antennas and surrounding city geometry align with the traced view.
Fine facade grids and antennas exhibit deterministic raster edge aliasing; analytic sky reflection is less faithful than traced facade reflections.

limitations: Single final frame per mode/case manually inspected; no continuous raster animation or native fullscreen/window-resize interaction inspected here.
No shadows, local traced reflections/refraction or indirect GI in ray-off. Transparent layers use batch-order alpha blending.
One-sample rasterization may show geometric edge aliasing/moire during motion, especially brick courses and distant facade grids; this is separate from stochastic path-tracing noise.
Local lighting budget64perfragment; most scene geometry lies outside the close Robie frustum, but the broad skyline still submits26.8million candidate triangles.
GPU timing does not directly equal native windowFPS.
